bulkdatasets.placeHolderText: Search title or description of bulk dataset

bulkdata.description: Bibliographic and assignments static Patent and Trademark data compiled into file sets.Entire Datasets (10-year increments) or Delta Datasets (daily increments) can be downloaded in bulk.

notes.value: Entire Dataset files contain Patent data consolidated based on patent application filing year. The initial entire data set is based on when the data is ingested into ODP application but not when the patent application was modified.
The dataset can be downloaded in 10-year increments and are updated weekly and can be downloaded in JSON format.

Delta dataset files contain incremental data that is new or modified data that has been ingested into the ODP application. It is refreshed daily (Sunday – Saturday) and is available for download in JSON format only. A new delta dataset replaces the respective dataset from 7 days prior. Delta datasets will be available for up to 6 days after they were released, until it is refreshed with a new delta set on day 7.
The file date shows the day of the week that the file is for. The initial release date shows when the data was originally published. The last updated date shows when the file was last changed.
To note: The delta dataset is NOT a cumulative delta for the week. Each daily file contains the last 24 hours of changes.
